text:
sam: quick sync. load tests show enrichment queue latency spikes, proposing a formal Deferred Enrich contract + explicit queue/backpressure policy.

priya: TL;DR of the problem? cost drift or correctness?

sam: both. heavy enrichers (geo/db) slow ingest -> either stall upstream or spike queues and delay billing attribution.

emma: we already do async enrichment but no SLA on how long attributes can be missing. downstream dashboards assume resolved billing-key quickly which causes flash updates.

ricardo: proposal sketch: 1) ingress emits a CompactEnvelope with core keys (request_id, tenant, route) + enrich_token; 2) enrichment service has bounded per-tenant queue + soft timeout T_async (default 5s); 3) if enrichment completes -> write resolved_billing_key; else -> mark provisional and emit token-based provisional metrics.

priya: what is enrich_token? high-card risk?

sam: token = sha1(tenant+route+shortts) truncated -> low-card hint. mapping materializes at enrichment completion. Token used for provisional bucketing only.

emma: we need determinism: add enr_outcome field (resolved|dropped|timeout) to envelopes so queries can slice by outcome.

ricardo: queue behavior when full? options: drop, shed oldest, or force token-only fallback. I prefer deterministic fallback -> convert to token-only and emit dropped_enrich metric.

priya: finance: dashboards must show provisional vs reconciled series. reconciled remains source-of-truth for billing. please add reconciliation-lag percentiles to console.

ops-bot: Note: sync-enrich feature-flag is OFF for prod, ON for canaries.

emma: rollout plan: (A) proxy: emit CompactEnvelope (FF) + small pre-enrich (<50ms) for debug flags; (B) enrichment svc: bounded queue, token mapping table; (C) billing: join table + reconciliation job; (D) console: provisional vs reconciled UI and reconciliation-lag hist. Canary 2% for 48h.

sam: tests: load test with synthetic slow enrichers; property test for token collision; end-to-end smoke verifying provisional->reconciled mapping under churn.

priya: rollback thresholds: auto rollback if reconciled delta >2% for 24h or dropped_enrich >1% sustained. ops wants dashboards during canary.

ricardo: edge case: multi-model fanout. include model-id in route-hash used for token to avoid undercounting per-model cost.

emma: add TTL for slim envelopes until reconciliation completes (default 1h). sampled canonical traces unaffected.

obs-bot: Created task OBS-4001 "deferred-enrich contract & backpressure" assigned to sam,emma,priya,ricardo.

sam: follow-ups: sam+emma: sequence diagrams + sample proto (ETA 2d). priy a+ricardo: token design + reconciliation join + dashboards (ETA 4d). em ma: tests + canary plan (ETA 3d).

priya: include sample proto in RFC, e.g.:
```
message CompactEnvelope {
  string request_id = 1;
  string tenant = 2;
  string route = 3;
  string enrich_token = 4;
  string enr_outcome = 5;
}
```

sam: great. I'll draft the RFC appendix and link it. tagging @emma @ricardo @priya. :+1:

ricardo: thanks everyone, this should keep ingest latency predictable while preserving billing fidelity.
